def: Belonging to another race or kind.
A yellow pigment found in the feathers of certain parrots.
Overgrown with brambles.Forlorn she sits upon the brambled floor. T. Warton.

The dorsal transverse, or tubercular, process of a vertebra.See Vertebra.
Pertaining to or engaged in the hunting of foxes; fond ofhunting foxes.
A Mohammedan rosary, consisting of ninety-nine beads. Byron.
Heated to whiteness; glowing with heat. "A candent vessel."Boyle.
